records.context: Return the worker count for a set of microscope image fields of view.
records.label: spacr.measure.resolve_pool_size#0
records.source: Return the worker count for a set of image fields.
records.translation: Skilar fjölda vinnsluferla fyrir safn myndsviða.

records.context: The count is capped at the number of fields for every start method. ``spawn`` and ``forkserver`` start a fresh interpreter for every worker, and worker starts are paced ten seconds apart, so a surplus ``fork`` worker also delays the processing session by ten seconds and then has nothing to do.
records.label: spacr.measure.resolve_pool_size#1
records.source: The count is capped at the number of fields for every start method. ``spawn`` and ``forkserver`` start a fresh interpreter for every worker, and worker starts are paced ten seconds apart, so a surplus ``fork`` worker also delays the run by ten seconds and then has nothing to do.
records.translation: Fjöldinn er takmarkaður við fjölda sviða fyrir hverja ræsiaðferð. ``spawn`` og ``forkserver`` ræsa nýjan túlk fyrir hvert vinnsluferli og ræsingar eru með tíu sekúndna millibili, svo umfram ``fork``-vinnsluferli tefur keyrsluna líka um tíu sekúndur og hefur síðan ekkert að gera.

records.translation: hve mörg svið á að mæla.
